title: Article 48 — Organisation of agriculture and animal husbandry

content.overview: Article 48 directs the State to endeavour to organise agriculture and animal husbandry on modern and scientific lines and to take steps for preserving and improving breeds and prohibiting the slaughter of cows and calves and other milch and draught cattle. Verify official text.

sections.heading: Directive content
sections.body: Agriculture and animal-husbandry policy; cattle-slaughter regulation is largely statutory and State-list sensitive. Related: Art 37.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Implement through statute or scheme. Article 37 bars treating this as a freestanding justiciable right.
